title: T3 — Project registers
body:
# T3 — Project registers

## Risks

No project-owned risk row is recorded; T3's live risks are carried on the programme register
(R3 shared binary/target race, R13 evidence theatre) and reviewed at the tranche cadence.

## Issues

The vacuous closure was the one issue; it is closed by this record set, not waived.

## Assumptions

The approver job remains distinct from the PM job; the standing delegation stays published.

## Dependencies

T2 (domain model), P0 (programme definition), and the spine primitives the PM path composes.

## Benefits

B1 (auditable decisions) directly; the demo credits record the five deliverables at the tr3 demo.

## Changes

`01a2052e-5648…` — accept the deliverables with evidence (approved).
